description: This file defines a class 'PdfSharpFeatures' which lists various feature names and their associated actions within the PdfSharp library. It organizes features related to PDF processing such as drawing paths, graphics, text, fonts, and PDF/A creation, and provides a way to access and run these features.

classes.name: PdfSharpFeatures
classes.description: A class that encapsulates feature names, their actions, and provides indexed access to features within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: this[string name]
methods.description: Indexer to retrieve the feature action associated with the specified feature name.
